title: Identity comparison on the strict finite tensor tower
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite and W a scheme with l invertible. Let D be an identity completion reindexing datum and T a completed tensor reindexing datum over D. Suppose D.QuotientGenerators and T.Generators, and a is the ordinary identity relabelling with its Over.mapId section formula. For good complexes P,Q, T.tower(P,Q) followed by the strict tensor-tower map of the two degreewise a components is the tower of degreewise a components on the original tensor tower. No derived tensor map, Roos map or resolution choice occurs in the conclusion. The constructions and notation are those of [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models].

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: Use QuotientGenerators and the section identity to identify reduction of the two ordinary identity components on every scalar tensor generator. T.Generators then computes the two paths on each homogeneous pure tensor. These sections generate each summand of the direct-sum total tensor before sheafification; the sheafification universal property identifies the maps after sheafification. Restriction of scalars keeps their underlying maps. Extensionality in degree and quotient index yields equality of the strict natural transformations, including all transitions.

mathlib_searches.query: A map of mapping cones is determined by both coordinate projections and naturality of products under an isomorphism to the identity functor
mathlib_searches.results: Found mappingCone.ext_to and ext_to_iff, map and mapHomologicalComplexXIso_eq. These give coordinate extensionality, not the section-normalized identity on these strict coefficient towers.

theorem podIdentityTensorTower
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E (𝟙 W))
    (hD : PodCompletionReindex.QuotientGenerators l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Generators l E (𝟙 W) D T)
    (a : isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (𝟙 W) ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (ha : ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E W) (U : W.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (𝟙 W)).obj U))),
      (a.hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapId (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤ W
          (𝟙 W) rfl).hom.app U).op x)
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    let α := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso _ (.up ℤ)
    (T.tower P Q).hom ≫ (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).map
        (Prod.mkHom (α.hom.app P.obj) (α.hom.app Q.obj)) =
      (isoWhiskerLeft ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj)) α ≪≫
        ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj)).rightUnitor).hom
